title: Sabboura
description: Logo, name and tagline: a flight simulator for teachers
speakerNotes: Sabboura means blackboard. Say the tagline out loud: «درّب حالك قبل ما تدخل الصف», practise your lesson before you teach it.

title: The problem
description: Teachers practise on real kids; the فاهمين؟ trap
speakerNotes: Every Jordanian knows this moment: the teacher asks فاهمين؟, the class says آه مس!, and half of them are lost. Most teachers only get feedback when someone comes to observe.

title: The solution
description: Plan, teach and reflect with a class of five AI kids
speakerNotes: Three steps: plan from tomorrow's real page, teach out loud to five AI kids, then get a calm review with one tip for tomorrow.

title: Meet the class
description: Five kids, each with one real misconception
speakerNotes: Introduce Omar and Lina in one line each. Lina never volunteers; only her badge shows she is lost.

title: Demo
description: 30-second video of a real lesson in the classroom
speakerNotes: The video starts by itself. If the browser blocks sound, press Sound on. Let it play without talking over the kids.

title: Why it isn't just ChatGPT
description: Fixed checklists, quoted evidence and code-based scoring
speakerNotes: One line: the AI judges against a fixed checklist and must quote you; code counts everything.

title: Built and working today
description: Features that already work in the product
speakerNotes: Stress that everything on this slide is working today, built on Replit.

title: Business model
description: 8 JOD per teacher per month; free for public schools via sponsors
speakerNotes: Private school groups sign one contract for hundreds of teachers. Public-school teachers use it free, paid by CSR budgets and foundations. Cost numbers are estimates until the pilots measure them.

title: Market and why we win
description: Comparison with Mursion and the expansion path
speakerNotes: Mursion proved the demand with human actors. AI removes the actor: cents per session, in Arabic.

title: The team
description: Mustafa Al Shammari, Yousef Al Masri and Ahmad Shadeed from PSUT
speakerNotes: Each person introduces themselves in one or two sentences: name, major, and the win or contribution on the card.

title: The ask
description: Ministry of Education and school partnerships plus 50,000 JOD funding
speakerNotes: Ask clearly: partnerships with the Ministry of Education and schools, and 50,000 JOD for operating costs, hiring, licenses and pilots. End on the tagline.
